brand.name: Argon
brand.tagline: The latest business news, straight to the point.

home.metaDescription: Business consulting for small and mid-sized companies. Argon reads the market every day and helps turn information into decisions, starting with the newsletter.

hero.heading: Clarity to decide.
hero.lead: Argon reads the market every day and helps small and mid-sized companies turn information into decisions. Start with the newsletter; when you need us, talk to us.

consulting.heading: Three steps, from data to decision.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.body: We gather the numbers, the market and the competition to understand where the company really stands.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.body: We turn the diagnosis into a few clear priorities, with targets and owners.

execution.title: Execution
execution.body: We follow the rollout alongside the team until the results show up.

events.heading: Regional events
events.body: The business calendar of Southern Brazil, in one place.
events.comingSoon: The calendar is being put together. Subscribe to the newsletter and we will let you know when the first dates are out.

newsletter.metaDescription: Get the latest business news in your inbox. A short briefing, no noise.
newsletter.heading: Business news, without the noise.
newsletter.subheading: A short briefing on what matters to founders, straight to your inbox. Takes under five minutes a day.
newsletter.honeypotLabel: Do not fill in this field
newsletter.consent: I have read and accept the <link>privacy policy</link>, and I want to receive the Argon newsletter. No spam — unsubscribe any time, in one click.

errors.invalid: That email looks incomplete. Check the format: name@domain.com
errors.consent: Accept the privacy policy to continue.
errors.unexpected: We couldn't complete your sign-up right now. Please try again in a moment.

success.title: One step left: confirm in your email
success.body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Your subscription is only active once you click it — and nothing is sent before that.
success.expiry: The link is valid for 48 hours. Can't find it? Check your spam or promotions folder.

privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.body: This content is still being written. Soon you'll find here how Argon collects, uses and protects your data.

confirmed.metaDescription: Your email is verified. Starting tomorrow you'll get the Argon newsletter.
confirmed.heading: Your sharpest thinking, every morning.
confirmed.body: All set! Your email is verified and you're part of the community. Starting tomorrow, you'll get a smart briefing on the business, tech and career news that matter most.

preview.label: Edition preview
preview.tagline: A quick shot of intelligence with your morning coffee.

market.title: What to expect from the innovation ecosystem in the coming quarters
market.body: The main trends in automation, venture investment and the new regulations that will shape technology decisions.

productivity.title: Focus frameworks that actually work for hybrid teams
productivity.body: How senior managers are restructuring async work routines to cut out the excess of useless meetings.

unsubscribe.heading: Unsubscribe?
unsubscribe.body: You will stop receiving the Argon newsletter at {email}. This takes effect right away — nothing new is sent after it.
unsubscribe.keep: I want to keep receiving it
unsubscribe.error: We couldn't unsubscribe you right now. Please try again in a moment.

invalid.heading: This link no longer works
invalid.body: The unsubscribe link is incomplete, or it belongs to a subscription that no longer exists. If you still receive the newsletter, use the link in the footer of the latest issue.

done.heading: Done — you won't hear from us again.
done.body: We removed {email} from the list. Nothing new will be sent.
done.alreadyBody: {email} was already off the list. Nothing new will be sent.
done.consent: I have read and accept the <link>privacy policy</link>, and I want to receive the newsletter again.
done.consentError: Accept the privacy policy to resubscribe.
done.error: We couldn't resubscribe you right now. Please try again in a moment.

reactivated.heading: One step left: confirm in your email
reactivated.body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Your subscription is only active again once you click it.
reactivated.expiry: The link is valid for 48 hours. Can't find it? Check your spam or promotions folder.

confirm.metaDescription: Confirm your subscription to the Argon newsletter.

confirming.heading: Confirming your subscription...
confirming.body: One moment. Please don't close this page.

expired.heading: This link has expired
expired.body: The confirmation link is valid for 48 hours, and this one is past that. Sign up again and we'll send a new one right away.

invalid.heading: This link no longer works
invalid.body: The link is incomplete or has already been used. If your subscription isn't active yet, sign up again.

error.heading: We couldn't confirm right now
error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Open the link from your email again in a moment.
